Source spelling 'Ababcock' (likely a typo for Babcock); carried verbatim.
Garbled model string in Crane-001 description; carried verbatim.
Source uses American 'Traveling' for Crane-002 and British 'Travelling' for Crane-003; both translated identically as 'رافعة متحركة'.
Station names translated into Arabic as 'سد أسوان 1' / 'سد أسوان 2' (the Arabic crane pages keep them in Latin script, but the Arabic target requires Arabic in every non-code cell).
Translated as 'دمياط سي سي' following the Arabic crane page's own rendering (CC = combined cycle, transliterated not expanded).
Station-type suffixes PS (power station) and GIS kept in Latin script as in the site's own Arabic pages.
